subject: Signage exception request — Moscone H4 backwall oversize
messages:
From: ExpoWorks Logistics <ops@expoworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Moscone H4 — backwall signage overrun and exception process

Hi Soojin,

On arrival for the pre-print check we measured the final art and the backwall panel — the approved artwork file (attached) will produce a finished graphic that is 6" taller than the Moscone H4 backwall clearance (top trim hits at 11'8"; artwork would finish at 12'2"). Photos and measurement log attached as measurement_photos_20260712.zip.

We know venue signage height rules are strict; Moscone ops suggested an exception route if the exhibitor (Redwood) signs off and the booth team provides additional bracing and a signed acknowledgment of the variance.

Next steps we need from Redwood to move forward:
- Confirm whether you want vendor to re-scope (shrink art) or proceed with exception (we will produce as-is but need signed site-variance).
- If exception: confirm who will sign and if you want us to add grommet reinforcement and edge bracing (recommended).
- Final pickup/ship window (we have a 48hr rush slot if you need reprint).

If we don't hear by Tuesday (2026-07-14 10:00 PDT) we'll hold the print and advise Moscone to schedule a site inspection the morning of load-in.

Attachments: measurement_photos_20260712.zip, initial_art_v6.pdf

Thanks,
Jared Marcus
Operations Lead — ExpoWorks Logistics
ops@expoworks.com
+1 415-555-0187

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: ExpoWorks Logistics <ops@expoworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Janelle Ortiz <janelle@vendorprint.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Moscone H4 — backwall signage overrun and exception process

Thanks Jared — and Janelle, looping you in since VendorPrint is doing the final production.

We need to move fast on this. Internal ask below:
- Marissa, can you confirm whether a 6" overrun is acceptable from a brand/visibility POV or if we should force a crop (we lose a small tagline at the top).
- Logan, if we approve the exception we'll need crate bracing specs and a quick estimate for onsite install labor (I expect +$300–$600).

Two options from Redwood:
1) Reprint at corrected size (no venue exception). Lead time: standard turnaround +48 hours for rush.
2) Proceed with oversize and request Moscone variance; vendor to add grommet reinforcement + reinforced top rail; Redwood signs variance and covers rush and bracing.

If option 2 is selected, I'll approve up to $600 for crate/bracing and rush costs; vendor please confirm final not-to-exceed estimate and provide DocuSign estimate so procurement can route.

I've attached the latest signage specs we want to stick to (signage_specs_v5.pdf) — Janelle, please confirm if that file will produce the 6" overrun and include the price delta for reprint vs. exception finish.

Sooj
Sooj in Events — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Moscone H4 — backwall signage overrun and exception process

Short answer: approve the 6" overrun with conditions.

Conditions:
- Vendor must add reinforced top rail and 4" grommeted hem; crate must include cross-bracing and labeled "fragile: trim overhang".
- Cost cap: Redwood will cover up to $450 for rework/rush printing and $150 for bracing/installation (total NTE $600 as Sooj noted). Any additional scope must be flagged to me.
- Tessa, please add time on the on-site manifest for one additional install crew member (2 hrs) and confirm load-in window with Moscone.

If Moscone refuses the variance, we will fallback to reprinting to allowed dimensions but execute rush.

Marissa
Sr. Field Marketing Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@vendorprint.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ExpoWorks Logistics <ops@expoworks.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Moscone H4 — backwall signage overrun and exception process

Hi all — we can do the exception and the reinforcement. Per your instructions:
• Add reinforced top rail + 8 grommets (4 per side), 4" hem, and rivet reinforcement at the top corners.
• Crate bracing instructions attached (we will include a rack kit).
• Rush print + reinforcement = $520 (includes expedited press, materials, and 1-hr install support on-site).

Attached: proof_final_print.pdf (for sign-off) and crate_bracing_instructions.pdf. I also opened a DocuSign estimate so procurement can approve: https://www.docusign.com/quote/EXW-3372-approval

Please reply ALL with either:
- "Approve exception — vendor proceed" (this will authorize VendorPrint to produce as-is and ExpoWorks to ship), or
- "Reprint to spec" (we will hold and reprint to the corrected size; cost difference will apply).
